SELECT s.superhero_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) >= 10
ORDER BY power_count DESC;
